dogecoin.text:
Tesla is about to accept $DOGE for payments. I don’t see a better use case. 

$DOGE is no more a meme. 

Utilise this info as you please.
Elon will hedge with $DOGE. Wait for his announcement, after which he’d dump and make gains in possibly billions, then rinse and repeat.
The next big market move will be determined by @elonmusk. And that’s for when he finally reveals that @Tesla will start accepting $DOGE as a currency of payment.

The biggest gamble for the year will have to be $DOGE. Get it right, and you could retire for the year. But the success of this resides in one man—and I think that’s too much gamble on the whims and fancies of one man. His name is @elonmusk!

Elon is a genius! He has probably gotten a ton of folks panicky and cashing out to USDT. And when the time is ripe, he’ll make them dump all that cash into $DOGE. 

Yes, he’d make this happen with a tweet.
Apparently, $DOGE fell to $0.30 as we slept. I woke and noticed that my Stop-Limit/Buy order was filled (processed) at an average price of 0.30USD.
@ay_adewale If there is any coin you should keep amassing at this time, it’s $DOGE.

The general market dip might last a while, except Elon reveals an integration of $DOGE with Tesla or some other form of intervention from big players. 

The main story here is, while this dip lasts, if you had invested all your savings in crypto, you will have to sell at a loss.
